notes.subject: בתי הנפש
notes.rationale: Literally 'houses of the nefesh', i.e. perfume-boxes or scent-vessels; 'ni' (soul) kept in the rendering with the sense glossed.

notes.subject: והלחשים
notes.rationale: Literally 'the whispers/charms' — amulets or incantation-ornaments; rendered as segekuruw (charm-amulets).

notes.subject: והצעדות
notes.rationale: צעדה (here 'ankle-chain') appears only here in the Tanakh in this sense.

translation: Kun-ŋolomaɲɛw, ni nugusesenw, ni kɔdaw, ni ni-sow (nu-kofenw so), ni segekuruw.
